reuse.why: Uses the existing shared tag parser extractTagsFromText and the existing isMonthFillCategory predicate rather than writing new tag matching or new filters.

duplication.why: The rule itself is written once; only the LEFT JOIN on notes for group_notes is added to both feeding queries (getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories), which already duplicated their category/group columns.

placement.why: The exclusion lives in isMonthFillCategory, the tree's single definition of which categories a month-wide action writes.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the two queries feeding it, types, comment and tests change.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; a small risk that a future query feeding the predicate forgets the notes join.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions reach the rule through isMonthFillCategory / getMonthFillCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the repeated notes join is data plumbing for the shared predicate.

one_place.where: server/budget/actions.ts isMonthFillCategory, used by copyPreviousMonth (via getBudgetData rows) and every action using getMonthFillCategories.
